liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Black Peter comes across as special; Black Peter is singled out as the soulful highlight of the soundboard set [9][13]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best Friend Of The Devil ever, with Jerry especially strong in set one [10]
- **From The Heart Of Me** (1 review): From The Heart Of Me is well done, followed by a solid Terrapin [13]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Runs 13:23, but the move into Playing In The Band lacks real inspiration, per this listener [6]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 other source): The first Playing In The Band has tape flips in both sources, at different places, leaving an unknown amount missing [4]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 review): Jerry shouts out U.S. Blues as the band heads into it [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-12-21.170803.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 188 min [1]
- **gd78-12-21.aud.cotsman.15209.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 151 min; rated 3.71/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is fuzzy and feels distant, as if taped from the back of the room; Sound improves markedly for Terrapin, with vocals and instruments coming through clearly; Audience tape is boomy and has some unfortunate cuts and splices, but it's the only source [6][7][8][9][10][11]
- **gd1978-12-21.152899.s2.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 94 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1978-12-21.170411.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 24 songs; 188 min [2]

## Around the show

- DeadBase lists no encore; Sugar Magnolia closed the second set, though the reviewer asks for confirmation [8]
- Of the December shows so far except 12/12, this is the first to energize the listener; Jerry sounds more engaged [7]
- Reviewer ranks it as their favorite show of 1978 [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-12-21.170803.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  April 25, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Uher Deck/Maxell UDXL-I) > FLAC (24-bit/96k) [1]. Also: Soundboard transfer was downsampled from 24-bit/96kHz to 16-bit/48kHz using Foobar2000 with dBPoweramp/SSRC by Tyler/MrCompletely; Audience cassette master to DAT to CD (shnid 15209) supplies patches for Friend Of The Devil and U.S. Blues [1]
- **gd78-12-21.aud.cotsman.15209.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd1978-12-21.152899.s2.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: taped by from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: unknown sbd cassette (low gen) [4]. Also: A soundboard of set two replaces what was previously only a distant audience recording; Tracks are pitch corrected; audience source 15209 supplies patches, including all of U.S. Blues and the start of I Need A Miracle [4][13]
- **gd1978-12-21.170411.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller          April 25, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Uher Deck/Maxell UDXL-I) > FLAC (24-bit/96k) [2]
